{"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab Ireland Ltd to GitLab BV in the Netherlands, how does the length and pay rate of paternity leave differ between the two entities?","answer":"In Ireland the employee receives 2 consecutive weeks of leave paid at 100% of salary (topped up by GitLab) plus a state benefit of €262/week, whereas in the Netherlands the employee gets 5 days of 100% salary birth leave and an additional 5 weeks at 70% of maximum day wage.","evidence_a":"- 2 consecutive weeks within first 6 months
- State Paternity Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)
- GitLab tops up to 100% salary","evidence_b":"* 5 days paid Birth Leave (100% salary), to be used within 4 weeks of birth
* 5 weeks paid Additional Birth Leave within 6 months (at 70% of maximum day wage)"}
